guards.name: acceptance_block_resolved_authorized
guards.description: G26: P-AUTHZ holds, the block came from RECEIVED or CLASSIFIED, the resolution names the reason with a future deadline, no effect exists and a classification is recorded for the commitment.

guards.name: all_effects_confirmed_absent_and_dispatch_stopped
guards.description: G01: every current effect is COMMITTED or CONFIRMED_ABSENT and dispatch is stopped; true when there are no effects.

guards.name: all_effects_reconciled_and_dispatch_stopped
guards.description: G02: every current effect is resolved or stopped, at least one is CONFIRMED, and each CONFIRMED effect has an authenticated provider receipt.

guards.name: any_effect_unknown
guards.description: G03: some current effect is CLAIMED or UNCERTAIN.

guards.name: authenticated_current_delivery_receipt
guards.description: G04: an ACKNOWLEDGED attempt for the current delivery and goal revision carries a provider receipt from the effect binding, reported by a SERVICE principal.

guards.name: authenticated_request
guards.description: G05: the authenticated actor is the requester on the commitment channel.

guards.name: authorized_and_no_accepted_or_pending_effect
guards.description: G06: P-AUTHZ holds and no effect intent exists.

guards.name: authorized_and_under_budget
guards.description: G07: P-AUTHZ holds and transition, request, tool-call and cost budgets have capacity; unknown cost with a cap is exhausted.

guards.name: authorized_current_cancel_request
guards.description: G08: P-AUTHZ holds for the cancel intent of the authenticated actor.

guards.name: authorized_effect_intent_committed
guards.description: G09: P-AUTHZ over the EffectIntent; the effect is COMMITTED, not stopped, under the active policy, bound to the current delivery and goal revision, with current evidence (RFC-014 dispatch recheck).

guards.name: authorized_feedback_current_revision
guards.description: G10: P-AUTHZ holds and the feedback or goal revision was given against the current goal revision.

guards.name: budget_exhausted
guards.description: G11: at least one budget dimension is exhausted, checked in the order transitions, reinvestigations, requests, tool_calls, cost.

guards.name: cancellation_not_yet_reconciled
guards.description: G12: at least one effect exists and neither G01 nor G02 holds.

guards.name: critical_input_missing
guards.description: G13: a blocking field is missing or the top two candidate scores are ambiguous.

guards.name: current_goal_evidenced_partial
guards.description: G14: an independent PARTIAL assessment of the current goal revision with evidence, at least one gap and current evidence.

guards.name: current_goal_independent_accept
guards.description: G15: an independent ACCEPT assessment of the current goal revision with evidence, no gaps and current evidence.

guards.name: deadline_elapsed
guards.description: G16: now >= commitment.deadline_at.

guards.name: delivery_block_resolved_current_evidence
guards.description: G17: the block came from READY_TO_DELIVER, the resolution names the block reason, no effect is in flight and the assessment and evidence are current.

guards.name: dispatch_may_have_occurred
guards.description: G18: some current effect is CLAIMED or UNCERTAIN and no acknowledged receipt exists for it.

guards.name: execution_block_resolved_authorized_budget
guards.description: G19: P-AUTHZ holds, the block came from an execution state, no effect is pending, the resolution names the reason and the exhausted dimension has capacity again.

guards.name: ledger_acceptance_committed
guards.description: G20: the commitment snapshot is committed, linked from the classification, and has an owner, next action and deadline.

guards.name: provider_proves_no_effect
guards.description: G25: a provider receipt proves no effect and the delivery attempt budget (behavior_policy.max_delivery_attempts) has no capacity left.

guards.name: provider_proves_no_effect_and_retry_budget
guards.description: G21: a provider receipt proves no effect, no other effect is UNCERTAIN, the delivery attempt budget has capacity and the assessment is current.

guards.name: under_reinvestigation_budget
guards.description: G22: the current assessment asks for more evidence and reinvestigation_count + 1 <= effective reinvestigation budget.

guards.name: under_transition_budget
guards.description: G23: transition_count + 1 <= effective max_transitions.

guards.name: unknown_effect_requires_reconciliation
guards.description: G24: the block came from the state the event resumes (EFFECT_UNCERTAIN for resume_reconciliation, NEEDS_RECONCILIATION for resume_cancellation), an effect is still CLAIMED or UNCERTAIN and the resolution names the reason with a future deadline.

actions.name: claim_dispatch
actions.description: Mark the effect CLAIMED, make the outbox row claimable, consume the approval and schedule a DEADLINE_CHECK in the same transaction.

actions.name: merge_feedback
actions.description: Merge the answer or goal revision; a new goal increments goal_revision, invalidates the assessment and stops every COMMITTED effect prepared for the previous goal; cancel the FOLLOW_UP timer.

actions.name: prepare_delivery
actions.description: Record the ACCEPT assessment and evidence, and commit the DeliveryIntent and EffectIntent as COMMITTED (not yet claimable).

actions.name: prepare_partial_delivery
actions.description: As prepare_delivery with verdict PARTIAL; the delivery discloses the assessment gaps.

actions.name: prepare_retry
actions.description: Return the attested no-effect intent to COMMITTED with the same effect_id and idempotency_key.

actions.name: record_blocker_with_owner
actions.description: Enter BLOCKED with block_reason DEADLINE_ELAPSED or BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.<dimension>, keep the owner and notify them; on confirmed_no_effect_exhausted, mark the attested effect CONFIRMED_ABSENT with dispatch stopped.

actions.name: record_blocking_question
actions.description: Send one blocking question and schedule a FOLLOW_UP timer at now + default_next_contact_s.

actions.name: record_cancel_request
actions.description: Stop dispatch of COMMITTED effects, request workflow cancellation and set a reconciliation deadline; also used when a goal revision arrives while a dispatch is in flight.

actions.name: record_cancelled
actions.description: Close as CANCELLED with effect_state NONE or CONFIRMED_ABSENT and notify the requester.

actions.name: record_candidate
actions.description: Record the candidate and its evidence and enqueue an independent assessment.

actions.name: record_classification
actions.description: Record the classification and set next_action to acknowledge.

actions.name: record_delivery
actions.description: Record the receipt, mark the effect CONFIRMED and cancel outstanding timers.

actions.name: record_effectful_cancellation
actions.description: Close as CANCELLED_WITH_EFFECTS and notify the requester with the effect receipts.

actions.name: record_escalation_and_next_review
actions.description: Send a rate-limited escalation notice and set the next review deadline.

actions.name: record_progress
actions.description: Record progress and set next_update_at.

actions.name: record_receipt
actions.description: Record acceptance and send the receipt notice.

actions.name: request_more_evidence
actions.description: Increment reinvestigation_count, reset the verdict to UNKNOWN and enqueue more investigation.

actions.name: resume_acceptance
actions.description: Leave BLOCKED for CLASSIFIED with the new deadline so that acceptance is evaluated again; acceptance is never skipped.

actions.name: resume_delivery
actions.description: Leave BLOCKED for READY_TO_DELIVER with the new deadline.

actions.name: resume_execution
actions.description: Leave BLOCKED for IN_PROGRESS with the new deadline and enqueue execution.

actions.name: schedule_reconciliation
actions.description: Set effect_state UNCERTAIN, stop dispatch of COMMITTED effects and enqueue reconciliation; never resend or delete an effect.

actions.name: start_execution
actions.description: Start the durable workflow and enqueue execution work.
